title: Six-week college tour with Nappy Lamare's band
summary: Zutty went on the road with Nappy Lamare, Brad Gowans, Stew Fletcher and Pud Brown, playing West Coast colleges for about six weeks.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yes, he lived in Riverside and then he moved to Sacramento. Yes, and he's living in there for a while. But in the meantime, before this happened you know, Nappy Lamdre was making up his band.
So I went on the road with Edmure Lew, Nappy Lemon, Brad Gowan and Stew Fletcher.
Yes. We made a tour of all the colleges. We played most all the colleges. Out on the West Coast.
From one end to the other.
Yes. You all were gone about, just about six weeks I think.
Yes, Stew Fletcher, he was with Norvo at one time wasn't he? You say he's out on the West Coast too?
Yes. He lives out there. He and his wife, Arlene. And his son was over to see us not so long ago. Well about, before I was taken sick.
